summary: DAY cumulative underwriting covers all 12 companies in Chief's active batch. Current primary filings and valid prior-cycle primary evidence now provide sufficient lane-specific inputs for Chief adjudication across financial/operating momentum, demand visibility, balance-sheet execution, dilution/leverage, customer concentration, governance/capital allocation, moat/pricing evidence and risk treatment. All 12 are ready_for_chief in this lane. This is not a positive-score assertion: several names require deliberately weak/penalized factor treatment because evidence shows concentration, dilution, leverage, pre-commercial status or non-binding demand. Future uncertainties remain documented instead of being manufactured into permanent blockers.

contradictions: NBIS customer commitments validate demand but simultaneously create concentration and financing/capex dependency; neither side should erase the other.
OKLO's large power-demand frameworks are not equivalent to current binding generation revenue; PMF/value-capture evidence must be scored conservatively until individual agreements become binding.
BTDR's AI infrastructure narrative remains economically secondary to current self-mining and financing risk; adjusted EBITDA must not overwrite GAAP losses/capital intensity.
SYM's very large backlog does not neutralize extraordinary single-customer concentration.

LITE's FY2026 GAAP net loss is dominated by a one-time non-cash debt-extinguishment charge; normalization is appropriate, but the equity dilution from note equitizations must remain in risk/value treatment.
unknowns: Current market valuation and consensus/crowding precision are not manufactured here; those belong to expectations-execution and may remain unknown where reliable sources are unavailable.
Future regulatory, demand-cycle and technology outcomes remain documented uncertainties rather than missing historical evidence.
